information: Lubitz SA, Yin X, Fontes JD, et al. discussed the association between familial atrial fibrillation and the risk of new-onset atrial fibrillation.
Brugada R, Tapscott T, Czernuszewicz GZ, et al. identified a genetic locus for familial atrial fibrillation.
Chen YH, Xu SJ, Bendahhou S, et al. identified a gain-of-function mutation linked to familial atrial fibrillation.
Weng LC, Choi SH, Klarin D, et al. explored the heritability of atrial fibrillation.
Roselli C, Chaffin MD, Weng LC, et al. conducted multi-ethnic genome-wide association studies for atrial fibrillation.
Low SK, Takahashi A, Ebana Y, et al. focused on a new genetic locus associated with atrial fibrillation in the Japanese population.
Lee Y, Kim TH, Yang PS, et al. studied Korean atrial fibrillation network, emphasizing the impact of early-onset atrial fibrillation combined with hypertrophic cardiomyopathy.
Choi SH, Jurgens SJ, Weng LC, et al. studied monogenic and polygenic contributions to atrial fibrillation risk.

genes.context: Chen YH, Xu SJ, Bendahhou S, et al. KCNN3 gain-of-function mutation in familial atrial fibrillation. Hum Mol Genet. 2003;299:254-254.
